decisions.reason: The existing message-96 MODIFY already records relocation of the two photos if they do not fit in the one-page letter, so no addition or edit is required.
Relocating photos within the proposal does not change the Canva source deliverable, ownership, or editability requirements.
The photo-specific relocation instruction does not change the established document-wide layout or graphic-treatment rules.
Moving two photos to another proposal section does not alter required narrative sections or resolve the Section 6 ambiguity.
The instruction concerns photo placement in the letter, not the background treatment of designated key pages.
The current-proposal photo relocation does not change the deferred modular-template requirement.
Relocating the photographs does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, logo source, or color source.
Relocating photographs to another section does not authorize reordering or redesigning the fixed RFQ section sequence.
The photo-placement decision does not affect typeface or font-size consistency.
The source decision does not change hyperlink coverage or required hyperlink functionality.
The one-page constraint applies specifically to the proposal letter and does not change the existing overall RFQ page-limit target.
Relocating two photographs does not change the required tables, budget sheet, or table replacements.
